scope: live skill identity, capability, routing, resource, and validation inventory under .agents/skills and .pi/skills

cpn_boundary.guard_policy: Skills are never invoked or loaded by guards. Guards inspect immutable token fields only.
cpn_boundary.invocation_policy: An external agent or harness consumes a correlated SkillInvocationRequestToken outside guard evaluation and returns a SkillInvocationResultToken or SkillInvocationFailureToken.
cpn_boundary.recording_policy: A later recording transition validates identity, input artifacts, result shape, deterministic command evidence, mutation scope, and authorization before producing evidence or finding tokens.
cpn_boundary.retry_policy: Every retry binds to an immutable parent authorization identity or a request's pre-authorized retry policy, has a new attempt identity, and preserves prior results and findings.

evidence_authority.deterministic_verification_result: May satisfy a software gate only when command, tool/environment identity, and input/output artifacts are recorded.
evidence_authority.agent_review_result: Produces findings and recommendations; it does not independently establish acceptance or scientific truth.
evidence_authority.parent_verification_result: Checks completeness and consistency of required deterministic and review evidence.
evidence_authority.human_acceptance_result: Human acceptance exclusively authorizes material scientific, architectural, public-contract, resource, or execution decisions.
evidence_authority.prohibited_inference: Multiple agreeing AI reviews are not an oracle and do not become numerical convergence, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, physical correctness, expensive-run authorization, or final acceptance.

skills.trigger_description: A nontrivial object model, public object boundary, or reusable behavior needs an explicit DataObject, ResultObject, ActionObject, serializer, Workflow, or free-function owner.
inputs: applicable accepted public and scientific contracts
affected data, result, operation, serialization, and workflow surfaces
side_effects: architecture guidance only; implementation requires separate task authority
external_tools_used: none required; bounded repository inspection may supply contract context
deterministic_scripts_used: none; no deterministic tool can choose architecture ownership
skills.authorization_requirements: Accepted authority must determine scientific meaning and public contracts; this skill does not authorize implementation or acceptance.
skills.failure_behavior: Stop when accepted authority does not determine a required public or scientific boundary.
skills.retry_behavior: No skill-specific retry protocol; reconsider only with corrected or newly authorized contract inputs.
skills.idempotency: The skill is advisory and performs no operational transition or mutation.
skills.evidence_classification: architecture ownership guidance, not software or scientific acceptance evidence
skills.current_validation_status: Simplified to durable reusable ownership guidance; historical correction and invocation ceremony removed while durable implementation consumers and the operator-domain skill retain the unchanged skill identity.
skills.stop_condition: Stop after the ownership decomposition and unresolved-decision report; do not implement or infer acceptance.

authority order, decision scope, and termination policy

skills.authorization_requirements: Human authority is required for architecture selection, checkpoint persistence, implementation, and acceptance.
skills.failure_behavior: Conflicting accepted identities or fewer than three defensible architectures returns conflict, deterministic, underspecified, or unsuitable and stops without checkpoint.
skills.retry_behavior: Requires immutable parent authorization or a pre-authorized retry policy, a new attempt identity, and retained prior results/findings.
skills.idempotency: Read-only analysis is observationally idempotent for identical artifact identities; a changed snapshot is a new input.
skills.evidence_classification: advisory architecture decision support; no implementation, VVUQ, scientific, execution, or acceptance evidence
skills.current_validation_status: Controlled harness-phase-six fixtures cover three applicable and five non-applicable cases; structural validation establishes procedure shape only.
hardening_applied: actual A/B/C plus D checkpoint interface
CPN correlation, retry, idempotency, and stop boundaries
skills.stop_condition: Stop after the decision document and checkpoint proposal, or after non-applicable classification; never select or implement.
